title: Machines with homeostasis could have a feeling-like device

statements.text: Machines that implement a process resembling homeostasis could be built with a feeling-like device that motivates and evaluates their behavior, and such a device may make a learner more adaptive to changing real-world data.

sources.quote: machines that implement a process resembling homeostasis could be designed to exhibit a feeling-like device for the motivation and evaluation of their behavior

sources.locator: cited in Man, Damasio and Neven 2022
